Support

How can we help?

Get help with scanning, NFC, iCloud sync, permissions, or using IDVault across your Apple devices.

Common questions

Why won’t my document scan?

Look for the machine-readable lines (MRZ) on your document. Allow camera access for IDVault and keep all of those lines in the frame. Use even lighting and tilt the document slightly if there’s glare.

Why isn’t the NFC chip reading?

Use a compatible iPhone and a document with a supported chip. Hold the top of your iPhone against the document and keep it still when a read starts. If necessary, move the phone slowly to find the chip.

Why aren’t my documents syncing?

Check that your devices use the same Apple Account, are online, and have iCloud enabled for IDVault. After enabling it, allow time for documents to appear on your other devices.

Contact

Talk to IDVault Support.

Tell us what happened, which device you use, and your Apple platform version. Including the IDVault app version can help us investigate faster.

Please leave out scans, document photos, MRZ data, and other identity details. We’ll never ask for your device passcode, Apple Account password, or encryption keys.
